findings.problem: The example leaves proteger in the infinitive after voy a, so the card's verb is never conjugated.
findings.fix: example.es: Mi hermano mayor siempre me protege. / example.en: My older brother always protects me.

back.example: I'm always going to protect you.

note: The yo form protejo is only a spelling change (g to j before o), so irregular false is correct.
